seriesTitle: Women in Blue (زنان آبی پوش) زیرنویس فارسی

episodes.title: María
episodes.summary: As a serial killer targeting women terrorizes the city, María, Valentina, Gabina, and Ángeles join the first female police force.

episodes.title: Paola
episodes.summary: María and the other Azules stumble upon a new victim of the Undresser and watch as a man they believe is innocent gets arrested.

episodes.title: Norma
episodes.summary: Dissatisfied with the detectives' conclusions, the Azules conduct their own investigation off the books.

episodes.title: Alma
episodes.summary: Another Undresser victim is found, confirming the Azules' suspicions. Their investigation points detectives to a new suspect.

episodes.title: Ángeles
episodes.summary: Romandía gets pulled into the investigation as the Azules uncover a clue that may reveal the Undresser's identity.

episodes.title: Laura
episodes.summary: The detectives take drastic measures to find answers. María seeks the help of someone who can offer new insight: a convicted serial killer.

episodes.title: Dora
episodes.summary: The Azules turn their attention to unsolved murders, hoping to find a connection to the Undresser.

episodes.title: Rosa
episodes.summary: María and Ángeles interview the adopted son of a woman named Rosa, who the Azules believe may have been the Undresser's first victim.

episodes.title: Gabina
episodes.summary: The Azules work with the detectives to stage a trap for the man they think is the Undresser—but things don't go as planned.

episodes.title: Valentina
episodes.summary: Season finale. The Azules pull their resources together to try and save one of their own, putting the future of the female police force at risk.

episodes.title: Mauricio
episodes.summary: New lieutenant María and the Azules set their sights on investigating the murder of a college student.

episodes.title: Filiberto
episodes.summary: An unexpected clue links the first victim with a second, kicking off a theory about targeted attacks.

episodes.title: Quintanilla
episodes.summary: After interrogating the surviving student activists, it's clear one of them is hiding something.

episodes.title: Arizmendi
episodes.summary: Detectives are convinced they know who's behind the killing of dirty cops. The Azules aren't so sure.

episodes.title: Lozano
episodes.summary: When another detective goes missing, fear sets in. María's night out with her daughter takes a turn.

episodes.title: Gilberto
episodes.summary: Anti-police sentiment continues to grow in the wake of the Executioner's latest victims.
